doc: Play the component breakout as an agent: at the human tier as a person plays, or assisted with the field's direct actions.

tools.name: field.observe
tools.description: What an agent player is shown at its tier: the step, the paddle, the balls, score, lives and bricks; assist also the rules and the hidden bricks

tools.name: field.play
tools.description: A person's actions: the arrows held, Space, Z — taking effect the tier's reaction after the step it saw
tools.undo: play again: actions hold only until the next

seen.description: the step it decided on (observe's step)

look.description: Z held: the whole of a tall room

tools.name: field.intend
tools.description: The intent the next play carries, never played: where it means the paddle to be and why — kept in the record, drawn with agent_overlay

tools.name: field.move_to
tools.description: Moves the paddle toward x (0 … 1) at once, as a pointer does

tools.name: field.aim
tools.description: Holds the launch's aim until the launch
tools.undo: the aim sweeps again after the launch

tools.name: field.launch
tools.description: Sends the ball on the paddle up, along the aim

tools.name: field.rewind
tools.description: Back that many frames for 100 sparks; playing on from there is a new branch
tools.undo: none: the sparks are spent (the branch it left is gone)

tiers.name: human
tiers.doc: As a person plays: what is drawn, a tenth of a second to react, ten actions a second

tiers.name: assist
tiers.doc: Privileged: everything shown, no delay, no limit, the field's direct actions
